evidence.quote: Gcore virtual machines start from €8.93/month for a Standard VM with dedicated vCPUs and free egress traffic. Pricing varies by VM type, region, and configuration — CPU-Optimized plans start from €15.01/month and GPU instances from €1.25/hour. extras.price_note: a VPS bills by the month with an hourly rate capped at the monthly figure, so the two columns answer two questions: destroying the box between runs versus keeping it up.
extras.price_basis: 10 h/day column = 300 h at the hourly rate, which is what a server destroyed between runs costs; 24/7 column = the monthly cap, because a VPS kept up all month stops at the cap. From the pinned catalogue card, not re-read.
